verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Semantic Views as schema-level database objects for declaring business metrics, entities and their relationships once in the database, which covers the core of a governed semantic model. Cortex Analyst answers natural-language questions without SQL and is exposed through the managed MCP server for AI agents, though the evidence never states that it answers against Semantic Views. missing for 10: explicit documentation of dimensions and join declarations, an evidenced link showing Cortex Analyst/AI tools query Semantic Views for consistent answers, semantic-view-specific governance details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
